//: The slots of a window. A plugin fills them with the entries of contributes.slots; it declares no slot of its own, only submenus. tools/slots.mjs writes the Go and TypeScript lists from this file.

slots.name: titleBar
slots.about: the bar at the top of a window; one view, the plugin of the title bar

slots.name: statusBar
slots.about: the bar at the bottom of a window; one view, the plugin of the status bar

slots.name: titleBar.commands
slots.owner: the plugin of the title bar
slots.about: the buttons of the title bar

slots.name: titleBar.status
slots.owner: the plugin of the title bar
slots.about: the views of the title bar, after its title

slots.name: statusBar.left
slots.owner: the plugin of the status bar
slots.about: the start of the status bar

slots.name: statusBar.right
slots.owner: the plugin of the status bar
slots.about: the end of the status bar

slots.name: fileTree.context
slots.owner: the plugin of the file tree
slots.about: the menu of a row of the file tree, over its file or folder

slots.name: tabStrip.context
slots.owner: the tab strip of the window
slots.about: the menu of a tab, over the file of the tab

slots.name: plexGraph.context
slots.owner: the plugin of the plex graph
slots.about: the menu of a node of the plex graph, over its note

slots.name: palette.searchResult
slots.about: the actions of a search result that is a note, over that note

slots.name: palette.note
slots.about: the commands of the palette over the note in front
